Emphasize the idiomatic Java practice of using `if (booleanVariable)` directly. Provide targeted exercises on constructing complex boolean expressions using `&&`, `||`, and `!` to accurately represent various logical scenarios, focusing on how to correctly combine conditions for ranges and mutually exclusive cases.
